description: Declared Obsidian MCP unavailable after receiving a 404 error on Mind/Posts/ path writes, then wrote all three content drafts and the weekly note to fallback filesystem paths instead of retrying or diagnosing the path issue. The Obsidian MCP was functional.
correction: Should have retried the Obsidian MCP with a different path format or verified connectivity before falling back. A 404 on a vault path does not confirm the MCP server is down — it may indicate a path format issue or missing folder that can be resolved.
systemic_fix: Before declaring an MCP unavailable on a 404, attempt at least one alternative path format and surface the specific error to the controller if uncertain. A 404 is a path error, not a connectivity error.
fix_applied: Updated weekly-step-02-draft-angles.md and weekly-step-04-weekly-note.md to use Desktop Commander (vault filesystem path) as primary write method for subdirectory vault paths. Updated workflow.md data sources table and integration contracts. Vault root documented as: /Users/davidohara/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Obsidian/
